name: Plot 2D
description: Chart an acoustic parameter (a dot per band, joined by a line), or the time or frequency response of Analyse Impulse Response (a line per channel), on the canvas: one chart per parameter connected, stacked. Drag the corner to resize; hover a chart to read its values; Save writes the charts as a PNG image.

inputParameters.name: data
inputParameters.description: Data to chart: acoustic parameters (a dot per band, joined by a line), or the time or frequency output of Analyse Impulse Response (a line per channel). One chart each.
